$comment: Command Governor dogfooding its own distribution.
The package source is the relative path `..`, which resolves to this
repository root -- paths in a project .pi/settings.json resolve relative to
the .pi directory. Loading the distribution the same way a consumer would,
through the pi manifest in package.json rather than through direct
`extensions`/`skills`/`prompts` paths, is what makes the conformance suite's
load test evidence about the shipped package and not about a shortcut only
A consumer pins a commit instead of a path:
This file is only read when the project is trusted. Pi's headless modes
never prompt, and under the default `defaultProjectTrust` they ignore this
file silently and exit successfully with an empty loadout. bin/cg-pi passes
--approve for exactly that reason. `defaultProjectTrust` is deliberately
absent here: a project cannot grant itself the trust required to read it.
